headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited approves QIP for ₹2,000 crore fund raise
sum: DIACABS board approved an enhanced QIP mandate of ₹2,000 crore (doubled from ₹1,000 crore), subject to shareholder ratification and SEBI/exchange clearance.
implication: QIP route enables institutional capital without pre-emptive rights, critical for infrastructure capex cycles; the doubled mandate reflects either prior capital deployment or expanded capex plans.
detail: Diamond Power Infrastructure, a power transmission/generation company, escalated its equity issuance authority via qualified institutional placement from ₹1,000 crore to ₹2,000 crore through board approval. The enhanced mandate is conditional on shareholder approval at an upcoming AGM/EGM and statutory clearances from SEBI and stock exchanges. No pricing or timeline was disclosed. QIP is the preferred route for large infrastructure plays requiring rapid institutional capital deployment without triggering pre-emptive rights obligations.
